judge_edits.why: The blind reader (item 3) stumbled on «действует на … и в …»: two prepositions under one verb. One construction for both sites, «один билет на X и Y», removes the mismatch and keeps the owner's meaning (one ticket covers both: ar «تذكرة واحدة تشمل»; sold through the village: ar «تُباع عبر «أرض الحضارات»»). «на Джабаль-эль-Кара» is the termbase form (non-declinable); «этнографическую деревню «Земля цивилизаций» (Land of Civilisations)» is the published card's own wording, accusative of the termbase generic (sklonenie: через этнографическую деревню), the name left in the nominative in apposition and the Latin gloss kept exactly where the card already carries it. «а продаётся он» shortened to a single predicate «продаётся через деревню»; «через» is the preposition the termbase pins for the village (#44, F1) and the published card has used since 92/100. Start «50 саудовских риялов (SAR) для взрослых;» byte-identical to current; no child fare, no purchase place beyond «через деревню», no final full stop.

judge_edits.why: Blind item 14: «в целом» is ambiguous (the craft in general vs. the Al-Ahsa kind). The owner's ruling is that UNESCO inscribed the bisht as such, with no Hasawi attribution (ar «والبشت عموماً», en «the bisht in general»). «бишт как таковой» says exactly that and cannot be read as a regional or partial claim. Everything else in the answer is byte-identical to current; no gloss added to «бишт» (already present on the page's card; source adds none).

rulings: Threshold 90; score 94 >= 90, APPROVE. Mandate: each position changes only what the source changed; every other word byte-identical to the pack (verified by script against pack.json for the legal paragraphs and the answer outside the changed clause). (1) ru-legal-lead: «прямо» removed, nothing else; accepted as proposed (blind item 17 calls the sentence natural). (2) ru-legal-mascot: «белоухого» -> «белощёкого» only; accepted: the owner decided «البلبل أبيض الخدين» / white-cheeked; the form follows the termbase model (белоухий бюльбюль, Pycnonotus leucotis) for Pycnonotus leucogenys, evidence cited by 05 from ru.wikipedia (article «Белощёкий настоящий бюльбюль»; the short «Белощёкий бюльбюль (Pycnonotus leucogenys)» in the lists of birds of Bhutan and of national birds); the termbase note is recorded below. The reader understood it as a bird and as a part of the brand; an added gloss «птица» would be outside the mandate. (3) ru-qarah-fee and (4) ru-hadarat-fee: the owner's meaning is one adult ticket of 50 SAR valid for both sites, sold through the village (stated on the Qarah card only; the Arabic and English of the Hadarat card do not say where it is sold, so nothing is added there). Judge edits (see judge_edits) unify the construction as «один билет на X и Y» to cure the preposition mismatch the reader named, keep the termbase forms (Джабаль-эль-Кара non-declinable with «на»; «Землю цивилизаций» inflected inside quotes as on the page's FAQ; «этнографическую деревню «Земля цивилизаций» (Land of Civilisations)» exactly as the published card writes it), keep «50 саудовских риялов (SAR) для взрослых» exactly, no child fare, no full stop. The tm FAQ precedent for this page (50 ... для взрослых, а в билет входит и посещение пещер горы Эль-Кара) uses «входит»; «один билет на …» was preferred because it keeps the owner's word «واحدة» (one) and puts the village and the mountain on equal footing without a possessive. (5) ru-stores-bisht: changed clause only: «и бишт как таковой с 2025 года включён в Список нематериального культурного наследия ЮНЕСКО». «Список нематериального культурного наследия ЮНЕСКО» is the established short Russian name of the UNESCO list (the full official title «Репрезентативный список нематериального культурного наследия человечества» would add words the source does not carry, so it stays out); neither termbase nor tm holds the phrase, so it is noted here for a pending termbase entry. «бишт» is the termbase form (Hasawi bisht entry, bisht entry), «ЮНЕСКО» as in the termbase. (6) ru-plan.tableEvent: «мероприятие» chosen over «событие». The site's own usage: the events page title is «Фестивали и мероприятия»; the single-event pages say «Мероприятие проводится ежегодно…», «Карта места проведения мероприятия», «Организаторы пока не объявили точное место проведения этого мероприятия»; the cards for recurring seasonal happenings say «семейные морские и спортивные мероприятия», «площадь для мероприятий»; «события» appears as the section name (nav.events «События», «Все события») and in plural lists. A singular tag for ONE scheduled, organised gathering (Palm Village) is therefore «мероприятие» on the site's own pattern; singular «событие» next to a place name would read as «a happening/occurrence» and does not match how the site names a single event page. It also corresponds to ar «فعالية» (organised activity) better than «событие». One word, lower-case, no punctuation. The blind reader understood «(мероприятие)» as «event» at once (item 10). Deductions: accuracy -1 (the UNESCO list name is the short form, not yet in termbase); nativeness -2 (genitive chain in the stores answer inherited from the list name, Latin gloss on the Qarah card mandated by the termbase); termbase -1 (the new list name and the white-cheeked bulbul entry pending); fit -2 (бишт and бюльбюль unglossed for a Russian traveller, outside the mandate).

source_defects.defect: The site is called «Аль-Ахса» in the legal text but «Visit Al-Ahsa» in Latin letters in the stores page; the reader paused at the switch.
Two Arabic-article renderings (Аль- / эль-) in one text read as a patchwork; both are termbase transcription rules, not changed here.

Hours differ between the two cards that share one ticket (jabal-al-qarah daily 8:00–23:00, ardh-alhadarat daily 8:00–22:00); the reader cannot tell whether the village closes earlier or one page is wrong. For the owner.
Cells with «—» in the third column and no visible column header in the excerpt; the reader could not tell what the column is.
«Женский народный рынок» is ambiguous (market run by women or market for women only; can a man enter?).
«Разиз» (date variety) looks unfamiliar and odd in transliteration.
«зари» and «бишт» are unexplained in the stores answer (the source carries no gloss there).
Vague causal claim about heat and rice properties; «чтобы он дошёл до полной готовности» is a calque («сварился» would be natural).
Leaked «[button → Как далеко от меня?]» marker and «Открыть в Google Картах ↗Заметили неточность?» glued without a separator; an artifact of the page cut, to be checked on the built page.
«Это включает» is a calque of «This includes»; natural Russian would be «Сюда входят». Outside the mandate.
The last FAQ question is shown with no answer in the excerpt (cut), and the reader could not tell who approves the stores.
«отключение некоторых файлов» without «cookie» in the excerpt; understood only from context.
The Land of Civilisations fee card says one ticket covers both sites but, like its Arabic and English source, does not say where the ticket is sold (only the Jabal Al-Qarah card does).
